notes.title: Version 2.3
notes.notes:
Improved Secret base forge mechanics.

If you fail to forge an item because you left one of the door open the forge will spit out the unchanged item straight away if the bottom door is open.

notes.title: Mac and Linux version available.
notes.notes:
Mac and Linux version are now available.

Some Bug fixing as well:
Italian translation typos
Bug using compass inside nuclear reactor fixed
Annoying trigger in the Secret Base Entrance fixed

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Fixes:
R3D STAR final countdown "speed run bug" fixed.
Strogoff is not present in the cell anymore during countdown.

Removed autosave from Silo scene during final countdown.

notes.title: Big inventory patch
notes.notes:
I went to the bottom of the new issues with the inventory. 
This patch should fix all the issues and it shouldn't break existing saving point.

notes.title: Broken Inventory in R3D STAR patch
notes.notes: Added a "clean" function on the Pause menu (Press ESC) that should fix a broken inventory scenario in R3D STAR.

notes.title: Patch: soft lock on photo
notes.notes:
To answer a possible problem with the [b]close button [/b]of the [b]fridge photo[/b] I made a small patch.

The button is moved and anchored in a different position in the hope it can fix the issue.

notes.title: R3D STAR - February update
notes.notes:
Hi Ducky friends,

Please bear with me while I'm working on R3D STAR! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135554/8d99a51a06d19e36d803accbc549428c87839a3d.png[/img]

Great news! [b]Part 2 of R3D STAR is about 75% done[/b], and it's already shaping up to be much longer than[b] D3AD HAND![/b] Instead of creating a new game, I’m fully committed to expanding and improving the D3AD HAND experience for all of you who enjoyed it and wanted more.

🌌 What’s Coming in R3D STAR part 2?
Join Yuri and Stalin as they travel deep into Siberia, uncovering the origins of a mysterious radio transmission. New locations, fresh mysteries, and exciting encounters await—alongside some familiar faces, like Vladimir the bus driver!

notes.title: R3D STAR: November Update
notes.notes:
Hi! I'm finalising the story and the characters for R3D STAR DLC.
I have already integrate the DLC in the main menù of the game, so all you will have to do to play the new episode is to select R3D STAR from the title! 

I want to thank everybody for the support and the feedback. I'll keep all of your comments in mind for this new bit. 

R3D STAR will have:

- Less first person puzzles and more classic adventure game puzzles
- New music and new characters (see illustrations)
- Stalin as a playable character.
- More sci-fiction elements 

Here you can see the sketches for the new characters of R3D STAR before being transformed into pixel art.

notes.title: Pressure puzzle bug fix.
notes.notes:
A bug on the pressure puzzle has been reported.
There was only 1 chance on 1200 to trigger it, so it seems so far it affected only one unlucky player.

This new version of D3AD HAND should prevent that bug from ever happen again.

Thanks for the feedback. 

Duck Made Of Wood.

notes.title: Version 2.1 - New Video Options
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, a new version of D3AD HAND is now available![/b]

[i]What's new?[/i]

Based on user feedback, we've added new video options to the video settings menu:

    Toggle full-screen mode.
    Play in a game window at different resolutions.

We've also made small adjustments to UI elements to enhance readability across various resolutions.

    A few typos have been corrected.
